IpInReceives.description: Total number of IP packets received from all interfaces, including those with errors.

IpInHdrErrors.description: Packets dropped due to invalid IP header (bad checksum, length, or version).

IpInAddrErrors.description: Packets discarded because the destination IP address was invalid or unreachable on this host.

IpForwDatagrams.description: IP packets successfully forwarded to another host (router behavior).

IpInUnknownProtos.description: Packets received using an unsupported or unknown transport protocol.

IpInDiscards.description: Valid packets discarded before delivery (e.g., resource shortages).

IpInDelivers.description: Packets successfully delivered to the upper-layer protocols (TCP, UDP, ICMP, etc.).

IpOutRequests.description: Total IP packets requested by transport protocols for transmission.

IpOutDiscards.description: Outgoing packets discarded before transmission due to resource issues.

IpOutNoRoutes.description: Packets dropped because no route to the destination was found.

IpReasmReqds.description: Number of IP fragments received that required reassembly. Each fragmented packet contributes one here when the first fragment arrives.

IpReasmOKs.description: Number of IP packets successfully reassembled from fragments.

IpReasmFails.description: Number of reassembly failures - due to timeout, missing fragments, or buffer/memory exhaustion.

IpFragOKs.description: Number of IP datagrams successfully fragmented before transmission.

IpFragFails.description: Number of IP datagrams that could not be fragmented (e.g., "Don't Fragment" flag set).

IpFragCreates.description: Total number of individual IP fragments generated during packet fragmentation from outgoing datagrams.

IpReasmTimeout.description: Number of IP fragment reassembly operations that timed out before completion - fragments that expired before completing reassembly.

IpReasmDuplicates.description: Duplicate IP fragments received during reassembly. Usually indicates network duplication or retransmission.

IpReasmOverlaps.description: Overlapping IP fragments received - may be due to network issues or malicious activity.

IpFragDiscards.description: Fragments dropped before being transmitted (usually due to route changes or memory pressure).

IpReasmMemFailures.description: IP reassembly failed due to memory allocation failure (kernel couldn't allocate reassembly buffer).
IpReasmMemFailures.hint: 0 ideally. Check net.core.rmem_max, net.core.wmem_max and net.ipv4.tcp_mem kernel values

IpExtInNoRoutes.description: Packets received but dropped due to no route to the destination.

IpExtInTruncatedPkts.description: Packets received that were shorter than expected and discarded.

IpExtInOctets.description: Total bytes received (including headers) on IPv4 packets.

IpExtOutOctets.description: Total bytes sent in IPv4 packets (including headers).

IpExtInMcastOctets.description: Bytes received in multicast IPv4 packets.

IpExtOutMcastOctets.description: Bytes sent in multicast IPv4 packets.

IpExtInBcastOctets.description: Bytes received in broadcast IPv4 packets.

IpExtOutBcastOctets.description: Bytes sent in broadcast IPv4 packets.

IpExtInCsumErrors.description: Packets dropped due to invalid IPv4 checksum.

IpExtInNoECTPkts.hint: If ECN is enabled (net.ipv4.tcp_ecn and net.ipv4.tcp_ecn_fallback) this value shall be 0
IpExtInNoECTPkts.description: Packets received without Explicit Congestion Notification capability (ECN=00).

IpExtInCEPkts.description: Packets received with ECN Congestion Experienced (CE) marking.

IpExtReasmOverlaps.description: IP fragment reassemblies detected overlapping fragments.

IcmpInMsgs.description: Total number of ICMP messages received, including errors.

IcmpInErrors.description: ICMP messages dropped due to internal errors (e.g., malformed data).

IcmpInCsumErrors.description: ICMP messages dropped due to invalid checksum.

IcmpInTimeExcds.description: "Time Exceeded" messages received (TTL expired or fragment reassembly timeout).
IcmpInTimeExcds.hint: Depending of the network conditions but shall be close to 0

IcmpInParmProbs.description: "Parameter Problem" messages received (invalid IP header field).

IcmpInRedirects.description: "Redirect" messages received to update routing tables.

IcmpInEchos.description: Echo Request messages received (used by ping).

IcmpInEchoReps.description: Echo Reply messages received (responses to ping).

IcmpOutMsgs.description: Total ICMP messages sent, including error and informational types.

IcmpOutErrors.description: ICMP messages not sent due to internal transmission errors.

IcmpMsgInType3.description: Count of received ICMP type 3 ("Destination Unreachable") messages.

IcmpMsgInType11.description: Count of received ICMP type 11 ("Time Exceeded") messages.

IcmpMsgOutType3.description: Count of sent ICMP type 3 ("Destination Unreachable") messages.

IcmpMsgOutType5.description: Count of sent ICMP type 5 ("Redirect") messages.

TcpActiveOpens.description: Number of times TCP connections were initiated by this host (via `connect()`).

TcpPassiveOpens.description: Number of times TCP connections were accepted in a listening state (via `accept()`).

TcpAttemptFails.description: Failed TCP connection attempts (no SYN-ACK received or connection refused).

TcpEstabResets.description: Established connections reset by the peer or by local host.
TcpEstabResets.hint: Low; frequent resets indicate network problems.

TcpInSegs.hint: Tracks traffic; healthy if checksum errors low.
TcpInSegs.description: Total number of TCP segments received, including those with errors.

TcpOutSegs.description: Total number of TCP segments sent, including retransmissions.

TcpRetransSegs.description: Number of TCP segments retransmitted due to missing ACKs.

TcpInErrs.description: Incoming TCP segments discarded due to checksum errors, invalid flags, or other problems.

TcpOutRsts.description: Segments sent with the RST flag to abort connections.

TcpInCsumErrors.description: TCP segments received with invalid checksums (detected corruption).

TcpExtSyncookiesSent.hint: Sent low unless under SYN flood.
TcpExtSyncookiesSent.description: Number of SYN cookies sent. This occurs when the system is under a SYN flood attack and TCP syncookies are enabled to protect against it.

TcpExtSyncookiesRecv.description: SYN cookies received and validated successfully. Indicates how many connection attempts were accepted via syncookie protection.
TcpExtSyncookiesRecv.hint: Recieved low unless under SYN flood.

TcpExtSyncookiesFailed.description: SYN cookies that failed validation (likely spoofed or invalid responses).

TcpExtEmbryonicRsts.description: TCP connection attempts aborted before completion (RST sent while handshake in progress).

TcpExtPruneCalled.description: Number of times TCP memory pressure triggered pruning of established sockets (e.g., during heavy memory usage).

TcpExtRcvPruned.description: Packets dropped from receive queue due to memory pressure or buffer exhaustion.

TcpExtOfoPruned.description: Out-of-order packets dropped due to memory pressure.

TcpExtOutOfWindowIcmps.description: ICMP messages received that were not within a valid TCP window (potentially spurious).

TcpExtLockDroppedIcmps.description: ICMPs ignored because of TCP socket lock contention (rare).

TcpExtArpFilter.description: ARP filtering applied to incoming packets (only in specific kernel configs).

TcpExtTW.description: Counters related to TCP TIME_WAIT state, such as recycled or reused sockets.

TcpExtTWRecycled.description: Deprecated in recent kernels. Used to count recycled TIME_WAIT sockets.

TcpExtTWKilled.description: Number of sockets forcibly removed from TIME_WAIT state to free resources.

TcpExtPAWSActive.description: Connections currently using Protection Against Wrapped Sequence numbers (PAWS).

TcpExtDelayedACKs.description: Number of delayed ACKs sent to reduce traffic.

TcpExtDelayedACKLocked.description: Delayed ACKs that could not be sent because the socket was locked.

TcpExtDelayedACKLost.description: Delayed ACKs that were lost or not sent before timeout.

TcpExtListenOverflows.hint: 0 ideally; some spikes OK under heavy load.
TcpExtListenOverflows.description: Incoming connection requests dropped because the listen queue was full.

TcpExtListenDrops.hint: 0 ideally; some spikes OK under heavy load.
TcpExtListenDrops.description: Total connection requests dropped at the listen stage (queue full or rate-limited).

TcpExtTCPPrequeueDropped.description: Packets dropped before they reached the TCP prequeue due to memory constraints.

TcpExtTCPDirectCopyFromBacklog.description: Packets directly copied from backlog to user space without queueing - improves efficiency.

TcpExtTCPDirectCopyFromPrequeue.description: Packets directly copied from the prequeue to user space.

TcpExtTCPPrequeue.description: Number of packets queued in TCP prequeue before user-space processing.

TcpExtTCPHPHits.description: Packets processed via the fast path (header prediction hit).

TcpExtTCPHPHitsToUser.description: Header-predicted packets delivered directly to user space.

TcpExtTCPHPAcks.description: ACKs that matched a header prediction path.

TcpExtTCPReneging.description: Segments discarded because the receiver reneged (retracted) a previously advertised window.

TcpExtTCPSackRecovery.hint: Depends on network quality; 1-2% of segments ideal.
TcpExtTCPSackRecovery.description: Number of TCP loss recoveries using SACK (Selective ACK).

TcpExtTCPSACKReneging.description: SACK reneging detected - remote host claimed to have received data but then NACKed it.

TcpExtTCPFACKReorder.description: Reordering events detected while using FACK (Forward Acknowledgment).

TcpExtTCPSACKReorder.description: Packet reordering detected during SACK processing.

TcpExtTCPRenoReorder.description: Packet reordering detected using Reno-style congestion control.

TcpExtTCPTSReorder.description: Reordering detected via TCP timestamp comparison.

TcpExtTCPPartialUndo.description: Partial congestion window undo triggered by duplicate ACKs (no full retransmit).

TcpExtTCPFullUndo.description: Full congestion window undo triggered when all losses recovered successfully.

TcpExtTCPRenoRecovery.hint: Depends on network quality; <1â2% of segments ideal.

TcpExtTCPSackRecoveryFail.description: Failed SACK-based recoveries (timeouts after recovery attempt).

TcpExtTCPDSACKUndo.description: Undo events due to duplicate SACKs (DSACKs).

TcpExtTCPDSACKOldSent.description: DSACKs sent indicating duplicate packet delivery.

TcpExtTCPDSACKOldRecv.description: DSACKs received indicating duplicate packet delivery.

TcpExtTCPSpuriousRTOs.description: Spurious retransmission timeouts detected (no real loss).

TcpExtTCPSpuriousRtxHostQueues.description: Spurious retransmissions caused by host queueing delays.

TcpExtTCPSackShifted.description: Counters related to optimization and fallback of SACK shifting mechanisms.

TcpExtTCPSackShiftFallback.description: Counters related to optimization and fallback of SACK shifting mechanisms.

TcpExtTCPSackShiftFallbackFailed.description: Counters related to optimization and fallback of SACK shifting mechanisms.

TcpExtTCPBacklogDrop.description: Packets dropped from backlog due to excessive queue depth.

TcpExtTCPLossProbes.description: Tail loss probes (TLP) sent to detect losses faster.

TcpExtTCPLossProbeRecovery.description: Recoveries triggered by tail loss probes.

TcpExtTCPChallengeACK.description: Challenge ACKs sent to validate suspicious connections or spoof attempts.

TcpExtTCPFastOpenActive.description: Connections using TCP Fast Open (client side).

TcpExtTCPFastOpenPassive.description: Connections using TCP Fast Open (server side).

TcpExtTCPFastOpenActiveFail.description: Failed TCP Fast Open attempts (client side).

TcpExtTCPFastOpenPassiveFail.description: Failed TCP Fast Open attempts (server side).

TcpExtTCPFastOpenBlackhole.description: Connections that disabled TFO due to middlebox interference.

TcpExtTCPToZeroWindowAdv.description: Counters for transitions in zero-window flow control.

TcpExtTCPSynRetrans.description: SYN retransmissions due to missing SYN-ACK replies.

TcpExtTCPOrigDataSent.description: Total segments of original (non-retransmitted) data sent.

TcpExtTCPHystartTrainDetect.description: Counters for HyStart congestion control - early slow-start exit detection.

TcpExtTCPHystartDelayDetect.description: Counters for HyStart congestion control - early slow-start exit detection.

TcpExtTCPHystartExit.description: Counters for HyStart congestion control - early slow-start exit detection.

TcpExtTCPDelivered.description: Tracks total delivered packets and those marked with ECN Congestion Experienced bits.

TcpExtTCPDeliveredCE.description: Tracks total delivered packets and those marked with ECN Congestion Experienced bits.

TcpExtTCPACKSkippedSeq.description: Various optimizations skipping redundant ACKs in those states.

TcpExtTCPACKSkippedSynRecv.description: Various optimizations skipping redundant ACKs in those states.

TcpExtTCPACKSkippedPktout.description: Various optimizations skipping redundant ACKs in those states.

TcpExtTCPACKSkippedTimewait.description: Various optimizations skipping redundant ACKs in those states.

TcpExtTCPRcvCoalesce.description: Number of packets coalesced on receive side for efficiency.

TcpExtTCPRcvCollapsed.description: Number of packets coalesced on receive side for efficiency.

TcpExtTCPAutoCorking.description: Auto-corking events to batch small sends together.

TcpExtTCPFromZeroWindowAdv.description: Counters for transitions in zero-window flow control.

UdpInDatagrams.description: Number of UDP datagrams delivered to the application layer.

UdpNoPorts.description: UDP datagrams received for which no listening socket existed (ICMP "Port Unreachable" sent).

UdpInErrors.description: Received UDP datagrams discarded due to errors (e.g., checksum or length mismatch).

UdpOutDatagrams.description: Total number of UDP datagrams sent from all applications.

UdpRcvbufErrors.description: Incoming datagrams dropped because the socket receive buffer was full.

UdpSndbufErrors.description: Outgoing datagrams dropped because the socket send buffer was full.

UdpInCsumErrors.description: UDP datagrams discarded due to checksum validation failure.

UdpIgnoredMulti.description: Multicast UDP packets ignored because the socket was not subscribed to that group.

UdpMemErrors.description: UDP datagrams dropped due to system memory allocation failures.

UdpLiteInDatagrams.description: UDP-Lite datagrams successfully received and passed to applications.

UdpLiteNoPorts.description: UDP-Lite datagrams received with no matching listening socket.

UdpLiteInErrors.description: Received UDP-Lite datagrams discarded due to header or payload errors.

UdpLiteRcvbufErrors.description: Incoming UDP-Lite datagrams dropped due to full receive buffer.

UdpLiteSndbufErrors.description: Outgoing UDP-Lite datagrams dropped due to full send buffer.

UdpLiteInCsumErrors.description: UDP-Lite datagrams discarded due to checksum mismatch within the covered portion.

UdpLiteIgnoredMulti.description: UDP-Lite multicast datagrams ignored due to missing socket subscriptions.

UdpLiteMemErrors.description: UDP-Lite datagrams dropped because of memory allocation failures.

MPTcpExtMPCapableSYNRX.description: SYN packets received requesting MPTCP capable connection.

MPTcpExtMPCapableSYNTX.description: SYN packets sent requesting MPTCP capable connection.

MPTcpExtMPCapableSYNACKRX.description: SYN+ACK received for MPTCP capable connection.

MPTcpExtMPCapableACKRX.description: Final ACK received completing MPTCP handshake.

MPTcpExtMPCapableFallbackACK.description: ACK received for fallback to regular TCP.

MPTcpExtMPCapableFallbackSYNACK.description: SYN+ACK received for fallback TCP connection.

MPTcpExtMPCapableEndpAttempt.description: Number of attempts to add an endpoint for MPTCP.

MPTcpExtMPFallbackTokenInit.description: Fallback tokens initialized for MPTCP connections.

MPTcpExtMPJoinNoTokenFound.description: Subflow join failed due to missing token.

MPTcpExtMPJoinSynRx.description: Subflow join handshake counters for received packets (normal path).

MPTcpExtMPJoinSynAckRx.description: Subflow join handshake counters for received packets (normal path).

MPTcpExtMPJoinSynAckBackupRx.description: Subflow join handshake counters for received packets (backup path).

MPTcpExtMPJoinAckRx.description: Subflow join handshake counters for received packets (normal path).

MPTcpExtMPJoinSynBackupRx.description: Backup SYN received for joining MPTCP subflow.

MPTcpExtDSSNotMatching.description: Data Sequence Signal (DSS) segments received that don't match MPTCP mapping.

MPTcpExtInfiniteMapRx.description: Received MPTCP segments with infinite mapping (malformed or malicious).

MPTcpExtDSSNoMatchTCP.description: DSS segment did not match any subflow sequence.

MPTcpExtOFOQueueTail.description: Out-of-order segment queue stats: tail dropped.

MPTcpExtOFOQueue.description: Out-of-order segment queue stats: queue usage.

MPTcpExtNoDSSInWindow.description: DSS segment arrived outside current window.

MPTcpExtAddAddr.description: Counters for adding new addresses in MPTCP endpoint.

MPTcpExtEchoAdd.description: Counters for adding new addresses in MPTCP endpoint.

MPTcpExtPortAdd.description: Counters for adding new ports in MPTCP endpoint.

MPTcpExtRcvPruned.description: Out-of-order MPTCP packets pruned due to memory pressure.

Ip6InReceives.description: Total IPv6 packets received from all interfaces, including those with errors.

Ip6InHdrErrors.description: IPv6 packets dropped due to invalid headers (bad version, length, or malformed extension headers).

Ip6InTooBigErrors.description: Packets dropped because they exceeded the MTU and could not be fragmented.

Ip6InNoRoutes.description: Packets discarded because no route to the destination was found.

Ip6InAddrErrors.description: Packets discarded due to invalid destination or source IPv6 addresses.

Ip6InUnknownProtos.description: Packets using an unsupported or unknown next-header (protocol) field.

Ip6InTruncatedPkts.description: Packets dropped because they were shorter than indicated by the header.

Ip6InDiscards.description: Valid IPv6 packets discarded before delivery due to buffer or resource issues.

Ip6InDelivers.description: Packets successfully delivered to upper-layer protocols.

Ip6OutForwDatagrams.description: Packets successfully forwarded by the node acting as a router.

Ip6OutRequests.description: IPv6 packets requested by transport protocols for transmission.

Ip6OutDiscards.description: Outgoing packets dropped before being transmitted due to resource limitations.

Ip6OutNoRoutes.description: Outgoing packets dropped because no route to the destination was found.

Ip6InMcastPkts.description: Total number of incoming IPv6 multicast packets.

Ip6OutMcastPkts.description: Total number of outgoing IPv6 multicast packets.

Ip6InOctets.description: Total number of octets (bytes) received in IPv6 packets, including headers.

Ip6OutOctets.description: Total number of octets (bytes) sent in IPv6 packets, including headers.

Ip6InMcastOctets.description: Bytes received in multicast IPv6 packets.

Ip6OutMcastOctets.description: Bytes sent in multicast IPv6 packets.

Ip6InBcastOctets.description: Bytes received in broadcast packets (rare for IPv6, usually zero).

Ip6OutBcastOctets.description: Bytes sent in broadcast packets (typically zero in IPv6).

Ip6InNoECTPkts.description: Packets received without Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) marking.
Ip6InNoECTPkts.hint: If ECN is enabled (net.ipv6.tcp_ecn and net.ipv6.tcp_ecn_fallback) this value shall be 0

Ip6InECT1Pkts.description: Packets received with ECN codepoint 1 marking (indicating ECN capability).

Ip6InECT0Pkts.description: Packets received with ECN codepoint 0 marking.

Ip6InCEPkts.description: Packets received with ECN Congestion Experienced (CE) marking.

Ip6FragCreates.description: IPv6 packets that were fragmented before being sent (by the source host).

Ip6FragFails.description: IPv6 packets that could not be fragmented (e.g., "Don't Fragment" equivalent, PMTU exceeded).

Ip6FragTimeouts.description: Number of IPv6 fragment reassembly timeouts.

Ip6ReasmReqds.description: Number of fragmented IPv6 packets received requiring reassembly.

Ip6ReasmOKs.description: Fragmented IPv6 packets successfully reassembled into complete datagrams.

Ip6ReasmFails.description: IPv6 reassemblies that failed due to missing fragments or memory pressure.

Ip6ReasmOverlaps.description: Overlapping IPv6 fragments received - rare but possible.

Ip6ReasmDuplicates.description: Duplicate IPv6 fragments encountered during reassembly.

Ip6ReasmTimeout.description: Fragment reassembly attempts that timed out before completion.

Icmp6InCsumErrors.description: ICMPv6 packets discarded because of checksum errors.

Icmp6InMsgs.description: Total number of ICMPv6 messages received. Includes all error and informational messages.

Icmp6InErrors.description: ICMPv6 messages drepped due to been received with errors (checksum failure, invalid type/code, etc.).

Icmp6OutMsgs.description: Total number of ICMPv6 messages sent.

Icmp6OutErrors.description: ICMPv6 messages that could not be sent due to local errors (e.g., no route, memory failure).

Icmp6InPktTooBigs.description: Received ICMPv6 "Packet Too Big" messages indicating MTU issues.

Icmp6InTimeExcds.description: Received ICMPv6 "Time Exceeded" messages (hop limit exceeded or reassembly timeout).

Icmp6InParmProblems.description: "Parameter Problem" messages received (malformed headers, invalid options).

Icmp6InEchos.description: Received ICMPv6 Echo Request messages (IPv6 ping).

Icmp6InGroupMembQueries.description: Multicast Listener Queries received (used by MLD - Multicast Listener Discovery).

Icmp6InRouterSolicits.description: Router Solicitation messages received (host asks for router info).

Icmp6InRouterAdvertisements.description: Received Router Advertisement messages (router announcing itself).

Icmp6OutRouterAdvertisements.description: Router Advertisements sent (if system acts as router).

Icmp6InNeighborSolicits.description: Neighbor Solicitation messages received (used for address resolution).

Icmp6InNeighborAdvertisements.description: Neighbor Advertisements received (used to confirm link-layer address).

Icmp6InRedirects.description: ICMPv6 Redirects received (router advising a better next hop).

Icmp6InMLDv2Reports.description: Multicast Listener Discovery v2 Reports received (more granular group tracking).

Udp6InDatagrams.description: Number of IPv6 UDP datagrams successfully delivered to applications.

Udp6NoPorts.description: UDP6 datagrams received with no listening socket (ICMPv6 Port Unreachable sent).

Udp6InErrors.description: UDP6 datagrams discarded due to errors (checksum or malformed).

Udp6OutDatagrams.description: Total number of UDP6 datagrams sent.

Udp6RcvbufErrors.description: Incoming UDP6 datagrams dropped because the receive socket buffer was full.

Udp6SndbufErrors.description: Outgoing UDP6 datagrams dropped because the send socket buffer was full.

Udp6InCsumErrors.description: UDP6 datagrams discarded due to checksum failure.

Udp6IgnoredMulti.description: Multicast UDP6 packets ignored because the socket was not subscribed to that group.

Udp6MemErrors.description: UDP6 datagrams dropped due to memory allocation failure.

UdpLite6InDatagrams.description: Number of IPv6 UDP datagrams successfully delivered to applications.

UdpLite6NoPorts.description: UDP6 datagrams received with no listening socket (ICMPv6 Port Unreachable sent).

UdpLite6InErrors.description: UDP6 datagrams discarded due to errors (checksum or malformed).

UdpLite6OutDatagrams.description: Total number of UDP6 datagrams sent.

UdpLite6RcvbufErrors.description: Incoming UDP6 datagrams dropped because the receive socket buffer was full.

UdpLite6SndbufErrors.description: Outgoing UDP6 datagrams dropped because the send socket buffer was full.

UdpLite6InCsumErrors.description: UDP6 datagrams discarded due to checksum failure.

UdpLite6IgnoredMulti.description: Multicast UDP6 packets ignored because the socket was not subscribed to that group.

UdpLite6MemErrors.description: UDP6 datagrams dropped due to memory allocation failure.

Nd6InNeighborSolicits.description: Neighbor Solicitations received - requests to resolve a link-layer address.

Nd6InNeighborAdvertisements.description: Neighbor Advertisements received - responses to solicitations or unsolicited updates.

Nd6InRedirects.description: Redirect messages received (router advising alternate routes).

Nd6ReTransmits.description: Number of Neighbor Solicits retransmitted due to no response.

Nd6ReachableTimeExpired.description: Neighbors marked as unreachable due to timeout.

Nd6Probes.description: Reachability probes sent to verify if a neighbor is still reachable.

Nd6CacheHits.description: Hits in the Neighbor Cache (analogous to ARP cache).

Nd6CacheMisses.description: Misses in the Neighbor Cache (analogous to ARP cache).
